findings.scope: T-25: Int64 log timestamps outside usual calendar dates
findings.limitation: The two inputs have not yet been run through the original Windows assembly. The observed browser precision loss is directly reproducible. This is not a failure of the unchanged pilot corpus.
findings.nextAction: Preserve Int64 event timestamps through DTO, graph and SQLite; then capture these same inputs with the original x86/x64 methods.

findings.actual: JSON.parse collapses the same pair of distinct Int64 numbers in the reference reader. An otherwise strict graph hash can therefore miss this class of difference.
findings.nextAction: Use lossless integer parsing in input/reference capture and add a negative-control test that must distinguish the two values.

findings.actual: 14 matrix rows pointed only at older browser evidence. Current main artifacts are SHA256-verified; 3 original 52-check reports and the 18-spec-per-engine results are now bound to the exact source hashes.
